comparisons.reason: Different constructs: feature 0 detects acknowledging validity of a point in the OP's view (intellectual) before a counter; feature 1 detects validating the OP's emotional experience before a rebuttal. Null/0 rules also differ: 0 yields null when no comment challenges and 0 only if a pure refutation exists; 1 yields 0 for any assessable case without qualifying comment, including empty list.
